total_cross_section: NIST Eq1 generalized BEB with Q (BEQ in Muller2009 terminology), n=1; modern CODATA2022 a0 central value and NIST R=13.6057 eV.
sharing: NIST Eq3 raw BED slow-electron shape with printed Muller2009 TableI coefficients, normalized to the adopted generalized BEB total per NIST introB procedure. This is an explicitly specified research combination, not a byte-exact clone of the NIST CGI.

coefficient_source.title: Source formulation for electron-impact ionization for fluid plasma simulations
coefficient_source.authors: Muller, Holland, Tynan, Yu and Naulin
coefficient_source.locations: Table I p12 of manuscript (PDF page index12), Eqs42-48 pp13-14
coefficient_source.retrieval: Full PDF read through web; Table I visually checked through screenshot. Local direct byte download403, so no original PDF SHA is claimed.
coefficient_source.rounding: Retain printed four-decimal coefficients; do not substitute remembered extra digits.

Ni_rule: Integral of the adopted printed polynomial on w in [0,infinity], sum(c_k/(k-1)); not copied separately from a rounded K_BED table.
sharing_domain_source: Muller2009 Eq47: slower electron W in [0,(T-B)/2]; both daughters retained in cascade. Lee et al2026 Eq2.13 independently states double counting above the half-energy boundary.
closed_total_reference: Independent adaptive integration of published symmetric BEQ SDCS, Muller2009 Eqs42,43,44 first expression, K=2-Q; this uses different algebra from NIST Eq1.
physical_accuracy: UNRESOLVED; no claim to reproduce original FS10 Monte Carlo or current NIST CGI numeric bytes.
